next.reason: §2023:14.9.37.4 GR3 restates 1985 GR8 point for point: the search index is VARYING index-name-1 when it is in identifier-1's INDEXED BY phrase, otherwise the first (or only) index-name (3a, 3c); an index-name-1 of another table 'is incremented by one occurrence number at the same time as the search index is incremented' (3c 2), which is 1985 a)'s 'same amount'; an index data item identifier-2 is incremented with the search index and an integer identifier-2 by one (3b). 1985 SR2 already limits identifier-2 to USAGE INDEX or an integer item, so 2023's 'integer data item' is the same set. 'All other indexes ... are unchanged' adds nothing a 1985 program can observe.
